name: Under Armour
note: 4Aces GC partner (livgolf.com/4aces-gc, fetched 2026-09-25). Ownership researched 2026-10-03: listed US company controlled by founder Kevin Plank (64.6% of voting power, 2026 proxy); no state in the chain and no qualifying human-rights finding against the company found in this run. Flag for the `none` company test: in June 2026 US Customs and Border Protection issued Withhold Release Orders on Under Armour's Jordanian garment suppliers Needle Craft and Casual Wear after finding indicators of forced labour; the suppliers produce garments for Under Armour per public supplier lists (Sourcing Journal/WWD, 2026-06-23). The finding is against the supplier, not Under Armour, Inc.
